lavender-paper.$description: Lavender Paper — Page canvas, soft card surfaces, hero wash — near-gray violet that reads as neutral paper across the entire site

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surface above canvas, icon strokes, inverse text on violet buttons, nav background

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Hairline dividers, card borders, input borders, separator rules — the dominant border tone at 2484 occurrences

onyx.$description: Onyx — Primary text, heading fill, dark icon strokes — the only body-color the UI commits to

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, muted helper copy, nav subtext

fog.$description: Fog — Tertiary text, disabled nav items, low-priority borders

ethereum-violet.$description: Ethereum Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Hover state on violet, dark accent surface, gradient origin — the violet pushed to its shadow end

hot-magenta.$description: Hot Magenta — Secondary accent for inline links inside feature cards, tag pills, illustration accent

sapphire.$description: Sapphire — Tertiary accent for links, icon variants, illustration cool-tone accents

mint.$description: Mint — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

lilac-wash.$description: Lilac Wash — Gradient origin for the hero radial glow and card overlays — never used as a flat fill

inter.$description: Sole workhorse — body at 16px/400, section headings at 24–30px/700, and display at 48–64px/900. The 900 weight at 60–64px is the signature: headlines are not politely bold, they are geometric slabs that anchor every section

ibm-plex-mono.$description: Used only for keyboard shortcut hints in the search bar (cmd/k label). Never used for body or heading
